hook.line: Use this prompt at your own risk.
hook.visual: Creator cut out over black, finger raised close to the lens, with a white pill title 'Use this ChatGPT Prompt at your own risk' and the prompt text behind him

beats.what: Warning title over the cut-out face and finger pointed at camera
Title drops; the prompt's role line fills the black background
Operating parameters block (IQ 160, one question at a time)
Rules of engagement: no sugar-coating, no excuses
Final instruction to start by asking about life goals

why_it_works: Forbidden-tool framing ('at your own risk', 'sociopath') sparks curiosity and a dare
The full prompt is on screen block by block, so viewers save or screenshot it to copy (7,410 shares)
A slow, read-aloud delivery (2.4 words/s) over a dramatic choral music bed makes a text prompt feel ominous
Close finger-to-lens gestures keep a human presence in front of a wall of text
weaknesses: 118 s of reading a prompt aloud with only 6 cuts; nothing new happens visually for 16 s at a time
His head covers much of the prompt text, so the thing to copy is partly hidden
No call to action; the value could be a pinned comment or link
for_robert: Avoid putting long copy-worthy text behind his head; if he shares a prompt, give it a clean panel Fred can point to and reveal block by block.
